title: An open D shape
summary: Start from the open fourth string.

steps.title: An open D shape
steps.body:
D means D major: D, F# and A. Leave strings 6 and 5 out. Use open string 4, fret 2 on string 3, fret 3 on string 2 and fret 2 on string 1.

**Why it matters:** A chord can use only four strings. The x marks tell you where to leave space, and the open D gives you the root.

steps.title: Read the positions
steps.body: Read the four played strings: D3 on string 4, A3 on string 3, D4 on string 2 and F#4 on string 1. The two D sounds repeat the root in different octaves.

items.prompt: Play D, A, F# together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Compare the sounds
steps.body: Build D with taps, then clear it with Escape. On your guitar, pluck only strings 4 through 1, one at a time, to hear the shape clearly.
